SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER AS BUYER, QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION AS REVISION FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = 'KRKEPB0004' AND QUOTATION_NO='RE10000010' AND QUOTATION_SEQ='000094' AND REVISION=1 AND IMPORT_FLAG='N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '01' AS PLANT, A.BUYER AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(A.QUOTATION_NO ,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(A.QUOTATION_SEQ ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(A.REVISION , 0) AS REVISION_NO, NVL(A.STATUS ,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.DESCRIPTION ,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION ,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(A.UNIT_MEASURE ,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(A.MAKER_NAME ,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ' ' AS ITEM_NO, '1' AS IF_FLAG, NVL(ATOB_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS IF_DATE, NVL(ATOB_TIME,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS')) AS IF_TIME FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT A SET A.IMPORT_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT A SET A.IMPORT_FLAG = 'E' WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
